'library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)

theme_set(
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", colour = "#31333F"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(colour = "#808495"),
      text = element_text(colour = "#31333F"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "#E6E9EF"),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
)

# Verteilung der Monatsrenditen pro Jahrzehnt
p <- dataset |>
  mutate(datum = as.Date(substr(as.character(Datum), 1, 10))) |>
  arrange(datum) |>
  mutate(
    rendite = Index / lag(Index) - 1,
    jahrzehnt = paste0(floor(as.integer(format(datum, "%Y")) / 10) * 10, "er")
  ) |>
  drop_na(rendite) |>
  ggplot(aes(jahrzehnt, rendite)) +
  geom_violin(fill = "#83C9FF", colour = NA, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.12, size = 0.6, alpha = 0.35, colour = "#0068C9") +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.12, outlier.shape = NA, fill = "white") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "#FF2B2B", linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(
    title = "Monatsrenditen pro Jahrzehnt",
    subtitle = "Violin + Boxplot + Einzelwerte",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL
  )

print(p)
'
